note: Money Tea Talks topics in order (the owner's list, 27 Nov 2026). Each Short tells one in the 4 steps: 1 hook (the result or the question, never the host first), 2 story (two invented people, one wise choice and one not), 3 proof (the numbers drawn by code: build.py scene kinds), 4 lesson (number cards, then the host's lesson and a comments question). Every number in a script is worked out by Python in the run and every rate is called an example. 'facts' must be checked in two good sources (RBI, NPCI, SEBI, the bank's own page) before the script is written; a fact that cannot be sourced is cut. A topic is used once its Short's description carries 'Topic: SLUG' (next.py).

topics.name: Start early: the same ₹2,000, 10 years late
topics.hook: Same ₹2,000 a month: one gets over ₹1 crore, the other ₹38 lakh. Why?
topics.story: Priya starts at 25 from her first salary; Arun says 'later', buys a phone, starts at 35
topics.proof: bars: compound 2,000/month at 12% (example) from 25 and 35 to 60: ₹1.30 crore vs ₹38 lakh; put in ₹8.4 lakh vs ₹6 lakh
topics.lesson: Start early, time works for you

topics.name: Credit card minimum due
topics.hook: ₹50,000 card bill, you pay only the minimum: how long until it is gone?
topics.story: Karthik pays only the minimum due every month; Divya pays the full bill
topics.proof: a timeline or bars: months to clear and the interest paid at an example rate (simulate month by month; state the rate and minimum-due rule used)
topics.lesson: Pay the full bill, not the minimum
facts: typical monthly card interest rate in India (from a bank's own schedule of charges)
how the minimum due is set

topics.name: Phone on EMI or wait
topics.hook: ₹60,000 phone: EMI now or wait 12 months?
topics.story: Arun buys on a 12-month EMI; Meena saves ₹5,000 a month and buys it later
topics.proof: cards: EMI × 12 vs the price; the interest is the difference (example rate)
topics.lesson: If you can wait, the interest stays with you
facts: how 'no-cost EMI' works (the discount equals the interest), from RBI's 2013 circular or a bank page

topics.name: Emergency fund
topics.hook: Job gone tomorrow: how many months can you last?
topics.story: Kavya kept 6 months of expenses aside; Ravi has 3 weeks
topics.proof: bars: months each can cover their expenses
topics.lesson: First an emergency fund of 6 months' expenses, then invest

topics.name: Inflation eats idle money
topics.hook: ₹1 lakh kept at home for 10 years: what is it worth?
topics.story: Paati keeps cash in a tin
topics.proof: a shrinking card: what ₹1 lakh buys after 10 years at an example inflation rate
facts: India's recent CPI inflation (MoSPI or RBI), to choose a fair example rate

topics.name: ₹100 a day
topics.hook: ₹100 a day on snacks: so what?
topics.story: Suresh orders snacks daily; Anitha saves ₹3,000 a month instead (and still enjoys some)
topics.proof: bars: ₹3,000/month at an example rate for 10 and 20 years vs what was put in
topics.lesson: Small leaks add up: save some, enjoy some

topics.name: Save half of every hike
topics.hook: A 10% hike every year: where does it go?
topics.story: Vikram spends every hike; Lakshmi saves half of each
topics.proof: bars: Lakshmi's savings after 10 years at an example rate
topics.lesson: Save half of each hike; life still gets better

topics.name: Save first, spend the rest
topics.hook: Saving what is left at the month's end?
topics.story: Ramesh saves what is left (₹800); Priya saves ₹3,000 on salary day
topics.proof: bars: 5 years at an example rate

topics.name: A simple salary plan
topics.story: A new joiner plans her first salary
topics.lesson: A simple plan beats no plan

topics.name: 'Double your money in 6 months'
topics.hook: A WhatsApp offer: double your money in 6 months!
topics.story: Uncle gets the message and almost sends money
topics.proof: rule: doubling in 6 months is +300% a year; real rates take 6 to 24 years to double
topics.lesson: Too good to be true is a trap: ask who benefits
facts: RBI or SEBI warnings about unregistered deposit schemes / Ponzi schemes

topics.name: PIN only to send money
topics.hook: The buyer says: enter your PIN to receive money
topics.story: Selling an old bike online, a 'buyer' sends a collect request
topics.proof: rule: the UPI PIN is entered only to pay, never to receive
topics.lesson: Never enter your PIN to receive money
facts: NPCI's own page on UPI safety: PIN only to send money; collect requests
